verdict.rationale: Community reports say Datadog publishes its prices on its website and that customers pay those listed prices without negotiating. That points to self-serve, published pricing, but the pack has no first-party pricing documentation. Predictability is also undercut by a concrete report of custom-metrics billing being switched on without notice (a ~400% bill jump) and another of a large customer leaving over lack of billing transparency. Missing for 10: first-party published per-signal pricing documentation (per host, GB of logs, span, custom metric), an official cost estimator, and evidence that bills are predictable from the list prices.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: price is always what's on the website
